title: elymus tauri
intro: Elymus tauri, commonly known as the Taurian wildrye or red wild rye, is a perennial grass species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Elymus tauri include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
